meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 它会持续跟踪一个 PR:反复查 CI 检查、评论和未解决的 review 讨论,核实后修真实问题、提交并推送,直到检查通过且没有待处理评论才停下。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、监控或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、review 和 CI,直到所有可操作问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我盯着 PR #123,直到它可以合并
say.note: 会轮询检查与评论,发现问题就修并推送

say.text: 监控这个 PR 的 CI 和 review 评论,有问题就改
say.note: 检查未完会保持等待,不中途停

say.text: 每 60 秒看一次 PR #45,把未解决的评论处理掉
say.note: 按你给的间隔轮询,核实后才解决讨论

howto.what_en: It keeps tracking one PR: re-checks CI checks, comments and unresolved review threads, verifies and fixes real issues, commits and pushes, and only stops when checks pass and nothing actionable is left.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it is ready to merge
say_en.note: Polls checks and comments, fixes and pushes issues

say_en.text: Watch this PR's CI and review comments, fix what comes up
say_en.note: Keeps waiting while checks are still pending

say_en.text: Check PR #45 every 60 seconds and handle unresolved comments
say_en.note: Uses your interval and resolves only verified threads
